title: Routing
summary: Turn one page into several with React Router: Routes and Route choose a page from the address, Link and NavLink move between pages without a reload, and useParams reads an id out of the URL for a detail page. You will add a catch-all route for addresses that match nothing and send the shopper to a new product's page from code after a form submit.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
